statement: For a fixed finite graph G, q^(-|V|) times the multivariate random-cluster polynomial with edge activities q*x_e equals sum_A q^(|A|-|V|+k(A)) x^A; its q=0 sector is exactly the forest polynomial, and every marked Rayleigh difference converges coefficientwise to the forest Rayleigh difference as q tends to zero from above.
closes: the exact q-to-zero representation and derivative passage for survivor M008
